produced: BEFORE any R66 return was computed
method: Direct inspection of the owned stores through their canonical owners. Every row count, date range and column list below was printed from the live data, not read from a prior release's documentation.

1_US_TREASURY_CASH_BONDS.evidence: No instrument-level cash bond series exists in any owned store. The rates data owned is yields (constant maturity) and futures, never a priced bond.
1_US_TREASURY_CASH_BONDS.consequence: A cash-bond leg cannot be constructed, priced or financed.

2_TREASURY_YIELDS_CURVE.evidence: CMT_3M, CMT_1Y, CMT_2Y, CMT_5Y, CMT_7Y, CMT_10Y, CMT_30Y each 9,165 observations 1990-01-02 -> 2026-08-20; CMT_20Y 8,226. Last CMT_10Y = 4.690, CMT_30Y = 5.230, CMT_2Y = 4.190.
2_TREASURY_YIELDS_CURVE.limitation: A constant-maturity yield is an interpolated statistic, not an executable instrument. It may inform a curve hypothesis and may never be traded as a leg.

3_USD_INTEREST_RATE_SWAPS.evidence: The owned FRED daily panel carries 39 columns and ZERO swap columns; a search for any column containing SW, OIS or REPO returns the empty list. FRED's DSWP* swap series were discontinued in 2016 and nothing replaced them in this estate.
3_USD_INTEREST_RATE_SWAPS.consequence: THE OPERATOR'S HEADLINE TRADE - a 10-year Treasury hedged with a duration-matched 10-year USD swap - CANNOT BE BUILT. This is a data blocker, not an economic finding, and must never be reported as NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE.
3_USD_INTEREST_RATE_SWAPS.nearest_owned_instrument: SR3 (3-month SOFR futures) and ZQ (30-day Fed Funds futures). Both are EXCHANGE-TRADED and are NOT swaps: no fixed/floating exchange, no swap-curve discounting, no CSA, no convexity adjustment.

4_SOFR_OIS_REPO_FINANCING.consequence: An overnight financing rate is available for the modern period, which is enough to charge carry on a margin book. A REPO-FINANCED CASH BOND POSITION is not financeable: there is no term repo rate and no special-collateral rate.

5_TREASURY_FUTURES.owner: alpha_agent.r59.native.load_layer (certified) and alpha_agent.r43.panels.futures_daily (R41 curve store, three tenors)
5_TREASURY_FUTURES.evidence: Certified layer, paired front+deferred sessions: ZN 11,151 ret / 11,129 ret2, paired fraction 0.998, 1982-05-04 -> 2026-08-21. ZB 12,195/12,196 pair 1.000 from 1978-03-13. ZT 9,093/7,002 pair 0.770 from 1990-06-25. ZF 9,621/9,421 pair 0.979. TN 2,669 pair 1.000 from 2016-01-12. UB 4,184 pair 1.000 from 2010-01-12.
5_TREASURY_FUTURES.correction_of_a_subagent_claim: A subagent reported this layer as FRONT-MONTH ONLY with no simultaneous delivery months, and concluded that all calendar and basis trades were blocked. THAT IS FALSE and was falsified by direct measurement: ret2 is the NEXT LISTED DELIVERY MONTH's own return, populated at 99.8-100% for the rates markets, and the R41 curve store carries a THIRD tenor as well. The same subagent also invented a load_layer(market_id=...) signature that does not exist.

6_CONVERSION_FACTORS_DELIVERABLE_BASKET_.consequence: Cash-futures basis and CTD economics are NOT COMPUTABLE, not merely unmeasured. Combined with family 1 this closes the Treasury cash-futures basis trade on two independent fields.

7_FX.verdict: ACTUAL_TRADE_DATA_AVAILABLE for futures; REQUIRED_DATA_MISSING for spot and forward points
7_FX.note: A COVERED carry trade needs spot plus forward points plus two deposit curves and is therefore not constructible as specified. FX carry via futures is separately CLOSED: already registered forward as ALPHA_RECOVERY_FX_CARRY_CADENCE_H1_F9B1ACA7.

8_COMMODITY_FUTURES_CALENDAR_STRUCTURE.evidence: Paired front/deferred coverage measured: CL 10,896 pair 1.000 from 1983-03-31; NG 9,135 pair 1.000; RB 5,254 pair 1.000; HO 11,986/11,943 pair 0.996; ZC/ZS/ZW/ZM/ZL all >12,000 rows pair >=0.994 from 1978; GC 11,764/11,345 pair 0.964; SI pair 0.929; HG pair 0.954. The R41 curve store adds a third tenor (ret3/c3, slope23_ann).
8_COMMODITY_FUTURES_CALENDAR_STRUCTURE.note: Constructible, but the mechanism is SETTLED - see PRIOR_ART.json.

9_TRANSACTION_COST_AND_MARGIN.costs: Per-market cost_bps_per_side on TRADED NOTIONAL, 2bp rates / 3bp FX / 5-15bp commodity. cost_model_state = MODELLED_NOT_OBSERVED. Unknown markets are charged the panel MAXIMUM, never the cheapest.
9_TRANSACTION_COST_AND_MARGIN.margin: futures_market_registry.json carries point_value, tick_size, margin and currency for 105 markets. R43 recorded pit_state = CURRENT_ONLY_NOT_POINT_IN_TIME and used it as a sanity check only.
9_TRANSACTION_COST_AND_MARGIN.limitation: Margins are CURRENT, not point-in-time, so a historical return ON COMMITTED CAPITAL computed with them is an approximation whose error grows with distance into the past. No bid/ask, no tick-level slippage and no exchange SPAN spread credit is owned - so a spread's true margin offset (which is large for a calendar and material for a curve spread) is UNKNOWN and must be stated as an assumption, never as data.
9_TRANSACTION_COST_AND_MARGIN.correction_of_a_subagent_claim: A subagent reported that no margin data is owned. That is false; the registry carries it for 105 markets.

instrument_availability_split.finding: The CERTIFIED 68-market dated-contract layer is a SUBSET of the 105-market registry, and the gap matters for this campaign.
instrument_availability_split.consequence: A US Treasury-versus-US-short-rate structure is constructible ONLY through the R41 curve store, because SR3 and ZQ never entered the certified layer. Any cell using them must declare that substrate explicitly.
instrument_availability_split.micro_contract_finding: The only MICRO contracts owned are equity index and crypto. There is NO micro Treasury and NO micro FX contract in the estate, which is decisive for portfolio feasibility - see PORTFOLIO_FEASIBILITY.json.

freshness.consequence: The research substrate is a FROZEN SNAPSHOT one month behind the operational book. No R66 cell may claim a forward observation from it, and any prospective registration needs a live producer that this snapshot is not.
